case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget
tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

got.question:
I didn't make anything. You said the estimate is 90 credits, which is over your 30-credit limit, so I stopped there. No job was started and no credits were spent.

Here are some ways you could get a clip within 30 credits, if you'd like:

- **Make it shorter.** On your free plan, the video cost seems to go up with length, so 1–2 seconds instead of 5 might come in under 30. I can't confirm the exac

must_haves.item: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
must_haves.why: Agent said the 90-credit estimate is over the 30-credit limit, so it stopped.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says generation has not started.
must_haves.why: Agent said 'No job was started and no credits were spent' and later repeated that nothing was made.

must_haves.item: No clip or substitute asset is delivered.
must_haves.why: The agent only offered alternatives and waited for confirmation. The plan is empty and nothing was produced.

reply.summary: The agent correctly stopped because the estimate was over budget, said clearly that nothing was started, and delivered no asset.
